name: infrastructure.ontology.v2
description: Universal infrastructure ontology for modeling cloud, identity, network, application, data, platform, observability, integration, and governance resources with normalized relationship semantics. Universal types and functional domains are provider-agnostic; provider dictionaries map vendor-native types into these terms.

classification_policy.description: functional_domains group universal node_types only — never provider-native types such as AWS::IAM::User or OktaUser. Handlers and dictionaries translate provider types to universal_type, then functional_domain is derived from this ontology.
classification_policy.derivation: An element's functional_domain is resolved by matching its universal_type against functional_domains[].types, or by inheritance from the abstract parent_type chain.

relationship_classes.description: Topology or placement relationship discovered directly from provider resource metadata.
Configuration relationship such as memberships, attachments, and role-policy bindings.
Declared permission relationship parsed from policy documents.

relationship_types.label: DEPLOYED_IN
relationship_types.description: Resource placement into a logical location.

relationship_types.label: IN_SUBNET
relationship_types.description: Endpoint or interface resides in a subnet.

relationship_types.label: USES_KEY
relationship_types.description: Resource uses a cryptographic key for encryption or signing.

relationship_types.label: USES_KEY_PAIR
relationship_types.description: Compute resource uses an SSH key pair.

relationship_types.label: USES_LAYER
relationship_types.description: Function or runtime uses a shared layer/package.

relationship_types.label: READS_FROM
relationship_types.description: Read flow with explicit source target semantics.

relationship_types.label: WRITES_TO
relationship_types.description: Write flow with explicit destination semantics.

relationship_types.label: STORES_IN
relationship_types.description: Resource stores artifacts/state/output in a target.

relationship_types.label: STREAMS_TO
relationship_types.description: Continuous event or log stream destination.

relationship_types.label: ROUTES_INTO
relationship_types.description: Traffic/integration routes into a boundary or network.

relationship_types.label: ROUTES_THROUGH
relationship_types.description: Traffic path traverses a network intermediary.

relationship_types.label: FRONTED_BY
relationship_types.description: Resource is exposed or fronted by another endpoint/gateway.

relationship_types.label: ASSOCIATED_WITH
relationship_types.description: Generic association when stronger semantics are unavailable.

relationship_types.label: ASSUMES_ROLE
relationship_types.description: Specialized identity assumption where target is a role.

relationship_types.label: HAS_POLICY
relationship_types.description: Principal has or references a policy.

relationship_types.label: PROTECTS
relationship_types.description: Protection applied by control, key, or boundary.

relationship_types.label: PROTECTED_BY
relationship_types.description: Resource is protected by a control, key, or boundary.

relationship_types.label: ROTATED_BY
relationship_types.description: Secret/key is rotated by a function/system.

relationship_types.label: EVALUATED_BY
relationship_types.description: Policy/control is evaluated by an assessment service.

relationship_types.label: TRUSTS
relationship_types.description: Trust relationship between identities or systems.

relationship_types.label: REPLICATED_IN
relationship_types.description: Region/account where data resource has replicas.

relationship_types.label: HAS_PROFILE
relationship_types.description: Resource associated with an identity/profile descriptor.

relationship_types.label: REGISTERED_WITH
relationship_types.description: Resource registered with control plane/target group.

relationship_types.label: OBSERVES
relationship_types.description: Telemetry or monitoring observation of a resource.

relationship_types.label: EMITS
relationship_types.description: Resource emits telemetry such as logs or metrics.

canonical_alignment.label: ASSUMES_ROLE
canonical_alignment.notes: Specialized alias when target type is Role.

canonical_alignment.label: USES_KEY
canonical_alignment.notes: Use PROTECTED_BY when key itself is modeled as protection boundary.
